name: text-edit-grammar
title: Text Edit Grammar
description: VegaStack Markdown v1 beyond CommonMark + GFM, as plain strings — mention links (parse, write, SQL twin), callout markers, toggles, media blocks, image widths, fence info and heading ids. No dependencies; server-safe.

meta.whenToUse: Reading or writing the Markdown constructs TextEdit stores — mentions, callouts, toggles, media, image widths — on a server or in a light renderer.
meta.whenNotToUse: Parsing a whole document — use text-edit-markdown.
